{"id":1960511573,"question_id":3215,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"3 months, 3 weeks","timestamp":1774584411,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"3 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1960511573/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Matrix Similarity After Cyclic Shifts","memory":"32.8 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    bool areSimilar(vector<vector<int>>& mat, int k) {\n        int n = mat.size();\n        int m = mat[0].size();\n\n        vector<vector<int>>grid(n , vector<int>(m , 0));\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n ; i++)\n        {\n            for(int j = 0 ; j<m ; j++) grid[i][j] = mat[i][j];\n        }\n\n        k = k % grid[0].size();\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n ; i++)\n        {\n            if(i % 2 == 0) rotate(grid[i].begin() , grid[i].begin() + k , grid[i].end());\n            else rotate(grid[i].begin() , grid[i].end() - k , grid[i].end());\n        }\n    \n        return grid == mat ? true : false;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"matrix-similarity-after-cyclic-shifts","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1871}
